description:
✅Powerful 70Nm Motor & Up to 120 km Range
The HITWAY BK15 4.0 electric bike is equipped with a high-torque 70Nm motor for strong pedal assistance—perfect for hill climbing and long-distance rides. The 48V 15.6Ah removable battery with anti-theft key lock provides an impressive range of up to 120 km (depending on terrain and riding style), giving you more freedom and fewer charging worries on commutes or weekend adventures.
✅26x4.0" Fat Tires with Puncture-Resistant Technology
Designed to tackle all terrains, the upgraded 26x4.0-inch fat tires offer superior grip, enhanced stability, and puncture resistance. Whether you're riding on city streets, forest trails, sand, or snow, enjoy smoother and more secure travel with peace of mind.
✅StVZO-Certified LED Lights & Reliable Disc Brakes
Ride safely day and night with a StVZO-approved front and rear LED light system, ensuring visibility in low-light conditions. The dual mechanical disc brakes provide powerful and responsive stopping performance in all weather conditions—ideal for urban roads or rugged trails.
✅Front Fork Suspension & Adjustable Rear Mudguard
The front suspension fork absorbs bumps and shocks for a more comfortable ride across rough surfaces like cobblestones or gravel paths. The wide, angle-adjustable rear mudguard protects you from dirt and splashes, keeping both you and your bike cleaner in wet or muddy conditions.
✅Upgraded LCD Display with App Function & Shimano 7-Speed Gears
Stay informed and in control with the multifunction LCD display, showing speed, battery level, distance, and more. The App connectivity feature offers smart ride monitoring and customization. Combined with the Shimano 7-speed gear system, this e-bike gives you smooth shifting and better handling across varying terrains.

components.description: Multifunctional LCD Display with APP and NFC
